summary: Add owner-local private Markdown notes with fenced typed client access

replay.detail: Only metadata-only requested/completed resource observations replicate. Content-free cross-action key reservations remain node-local. Markdown, revisions, content digests and private recovery receipts never enter the graph.

schema.detail: Adds typed private-notes client subjects, fences and write actions plus a strict notes URI observation profile. A separate owner-local SQLite ledger records filesystem operation recovery; no replicated storage version change.

rules.detail: Notes reads require read.projections. Writes require control.work and a concrete person or local agent acting party, including paired client sessions acting for a person, with carrier-generation and revision compare-and-swap. Notes share the client action idempotency conflict checks while keeping exact-content matching owner-local. Agent avoidance remains operational policy, not person-only authorization.

compatibility.detail: Adds private_notes_catalogs configuration and an additive GET/action client contract while preserving current-main native producer status, usage, redaction, truncation and unknown attachment behavior. Depends on declared-resource references; this PR intentionally remains stacked on that prerequisite.

downtime.detail: No fleet migration is required; configure absolute owner-local catalog roots before accessing notes.

manual.detail: Declare the exact canonical self URI in the catalog agent declaration and use the API for coordinated writes. Sources must be owner-owned, non-symlink and not group/world writable. Do not copy private ledger or Markdown into replicated claims.

recovery.detail: A content-free shared action key reservation and attributed intent precede durable filesystem replacement. Interrupted replacement or failed completion audit retains that reservation, excluding other actions with the same key while the original exact notes request reconciles; recovery retains the original requested transport attribution. External edits invalidate revision fences.
